title: Lead Wordpress Developer
description:
About Olly Olly

Olly Olly is a $25M ARR digital marketing company serving small businesses across the United States. We’ve built our reputation on transparency, results, and making sophisticated marketing accessible to business owners who need to focus on running their companies, not learning marketing complexities. As we scale our platform and demand generation efforts, we’re looking for an exceptional WordPress developer who can lead our landing page creation and optimization function.

The Role

We’re seeking a battle-tested WordPress Developer & Landing Page Team Lead who has personally managed the technical execution of high-stakes marketing campaigns with millions of dollars in ad spend. This isn’t a role for someone who’s built a few landing pages—we need someone who has been THE person responsible for ensuring every pixel fires correctly, every form submits properly, and every dollar of ad spend has a clear path to conversion tracking.

You’ll lead a team of two WordPress developers, managing multiple concurrent projects while maintaining the exacting standards required when significant marketing budgets are on the line. You’ll be the technical bridge between our marketing campaigns (primarily Meta, but across various channels) and our HubSpot CRM, ensuring flawless data flow and attribution tracking.

Core Responsibilities

Landing Page Development & Campaign Execution

  • Design, build, and deploy high-converting landing pages optimized for paid traffic from Meta, Google, and other advertising platforms
  • Own the complete technical implementation of marketing campaigns from concept through launch
  • Ensure pixel-perfect tracking setup across all campaigns, including Meta Pixel, Google Analytics, conversion tracking, and retargeting audiences
  • Implement and troubleshoot complex tracking scenarios including server-side tracking, UTM parameters, and multi-touch attribution
  • Optimize landing page performance for speed, mobile responsiveness, and conversion rates
  • Conduct A / B testing and implement rapid iterations based on campaign performance data

HubSpot Integration & Data Management

  • Build and maintain seamless integrations between landing pages and HubSpot CRM
  • Ensure accurate lead capture, form submissions, and data synchronization
  • Implement and validate proper lead source attribution and campaign tracking in HubSpot
  • Create custom workflows and automations to support campaign objectives
  • Troubleshoot data discrepancies and ensure marketing attribution accuracy

Technical Leadership & Team Management

  • Lead and mentor a team of two WordPress developers
  • Manage workload distribution across multiple concurrent projects and campaigns
  • Establish and enforce development standards, quality assurance protocols, and best practices
  • Conduct code reviews and provide constructive technical feedback
  • Create project timelines and ensure on-time delivery of campaign assets
  • Serve as the escalation point for complex technical challenges

Quality Assurance & Risk Management

  • Implement rigorous QA processes, before any campaign launch.
  • Verify all tracking mechanisms are functioning correctly across devices and browsers
  • Maintain detailed documentation of tracking implementations and technical specifications
  • Proactively identify and resolve potential issues before they impact campaign performance
  • Ensure compliance with privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA) in all tracking implementations

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional WordPress development experience
  • Direct experience managing technical execution of marketing campaigns with $1M+ in total ad spend
  • Must have been the PRIMARY person responsible for landing page build and campaign launch (not just a contributor on a larger team)
  • Portfolio demonstrating high-converting landing pages you’ve personally built and deployed

Technical Expertise

  • Proven experience implementing Git-based version control (GitLab, GitHub, or Bitbucket) and configuring Continuous Integration / Continuous Delivery (CI / CD) pipelines for WordPress. Must be proficient in automating deployment across environments (Dev, Staging, Prod) and integrating unit and end-to-end tests into the workflow.
  • Expert-level WordPress development skills including ACF. Gutenberg, custom theme development, plugin customization, and advanced page builders (Elementor, Divi, or similar)
  • Deep understanding of Meta Business Suite, Meta Pixel implementation, and Conversions API
  • Proven experience with HubSpot CRM integration, forms, and tracking implementation
  • Strong command of HTML, CSS, JavaScript / jQuery, and PHP
  • Experience with VueJS is a plus
  • Experience with conversion tracking pixels across multiple platforms (Meta, Google, , etc.)
  • Knowledge of Google Tag Manager and server-side tracking implementations
  • Understanding of marketing analytics, attribution models, and conversion optimization principles

Management & Communication

  • Demonstrated experience leading and mentoring developers
  • Exceptional project management skills with the ability to juggle multiple high-priority projects
  • Clear communication style with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Comfortable with accountability when significant marketing budgets are at stake
  • Ability to explain complex technical concepts to marketing team members

Performance Standards

  • Meticulous attention to detail—one misconfigured pixel can cost thousands in wasted ad spend
  • Ability to work under pressure and meet tight campaign launch deadlines
  • Proactive problem-solver who anticipates issues before they become problems
  • Commitment to continuous learning as platforms and tracking methods evolve

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with marketing automation platforms beyond HubSpot (Marketo, Pardot, ActiveCampaign)
  • Familiarity with conversion rate optimization (CRO) methodologies and tools
  • Knowledge of SQL for custom reporting and data analysis
  • Experience with A / B testing platforms (VWO, Optimizely, Google Optimize)
  • Understanding of SEO best practices for landing pages
  • Certifications in Meta Blueprint, Google Analytics, or HubSpot
  • Experience in agency or fast-paced startup environments

What Success Looks Like

First 30 Days

  • Audit current landing page infrastructure and tracking implementations
  • Meet with marketing team to understand campaign objectives and conversion goals
  • Review existing team workflows and identify optimization opportunities
  • Successfully launch first campaign under your management with zero tracking issues

First 90 Days

  • Establish standardized QA protocols and documentation for all campaign launches
  • Implement improvements to team efficiency and project management processes
  • Build trust with marketing team through flawless technical execution
  • Identify and resolve any lingering tracking or integration issues

First Year

  • Lead team through successful execution of major product launch campaigns
  • Demonstrably improve landing page conversion rates through testing and optimization
  • Establish Olly Olly’s landing page function as a competitive advantage
  • Develop your team members’ skills and create succession planning

Why This Role Matters

When we invest in marketing campaigns, every dollar needs to count. You’ll be the person ensuring that our tracking is accurate, our data is clean, and our ability to optimize is never compromised by technical issues. Your work directly impacts our ability to scale profitably and serve more small business owners.

Compensation & Benefits

Competitive salary commensurate with experience, plus comprehensive benefits package. This is a full-time remote position, though you’ll be working closely with team members across time zones.

Our Culture

We value directness, authenticity, and results over politics or polish. We’re building something meaningful for small business owners who are often underserved by the marketing industry. We expect excellence but also recognize that real growth happens when people are supported, challenged, and given autonomy to do their best work.

O Auxiliar de Operador de Câmera atua prestando suporte técnico e operacional aos operadores de câmera durante gravações, transmissões ao vivo e externas, garantindo que os equipamentos estejam corretamente montados, ajustados e em perfeitas condições de uso. Contribui para a fluidez das operações de captação de imagem, seguindo orientações da direção, produção e equipe técnica.

Responsabilidades

  • Auxiliar na montagem, desmontagem, transporte e organização dos equipamentos de captação de imagem (câmeras, tripés, lentes, cabos, baterias e acessórios).
  • Apoiar o operador de câmera nos ajustes básicos de equipamento, como posicionamento, troca de lentes, cabos, baterias e acessórios.
  • Realizar testes simples de funcionamento dos equipamentos antes, durante e após gravações ou transmissões.
  • Organizar e zelar pelos equipamentos sob sua responsabilidade, comunicando falhas ou necessidades de manutenção à equipe técnica.
  • Apoiar na movimentação de câmeras em estúdio e externas, respeitando normas de segurança e orientações de produção.
  • Auxiliar na organização do set, estúdio ou local de externa, mantendo o ambiente adequado para gravação.
  • Seguir orientações da direção, produção e operador de câmera durante gravações e transmissões ao vivo.
  • ​Cumprir normas de segurança, uso de EPI e boas práticas de operação dos equipamentos.

Requisitos

  • Ensino médio completo.
  • Interesse ou experiência inicial na área audiovisual, televisão ou produção de vídeo.
  • Noções básicas de equipamentos de captação de imagem e ambiente de estúdio/externa.
  • Boa disposição física para montagem e transporte de equipamentos.
  • Organização, atenção, responsabilidade e capacidade de trabalhar em equipe.
  • Disponibilidade para horários flexíveis, externas, finais de semana e feriados.

Diferenciais

  • Curso técnico ou formação em Produção Audiovisual, Rádio e TV, Cinema ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência prévia como auxiliar de câmera, assistente de vídeo ou produção técnica.
  • Interesse em desenvolvimento profissional para futura atuação como Operador de Câmera.

Adicionais

description:
Descrição da vaga

Um dos maiores grupos de beleza do mundo, o Grupo Boticário é uma empresa brasileira presente em mais de 40 países. É dono das marcas O Boticário, Eudora, Quem Disse, Berenice?, Vult, O.U.i, Dr. JONES, Tô.que.tô, TRUSS, e do marketplace Beleza na Web, além de atuar com produtos licenciados como Australian Gold, Bio Oil, Nuxe, e Pampers e sua divisão para o mercado B2B. Essa interação entre diferentes marcas, ativos, plataformas, rede de franqueados, representantes, distribuidores, varejistas, sellers e fornecedores formam o ecossistema de beleza do Grupo Boticário que oferece, ainda, soluções digitais de gestão de negócio para o varejo brasileiro por meio das suas marcas Mooz, Casa Magalhães e GAVB. São mais de 19 mil colaboradores diretos, com mais de 4 mil lojas em 1.780 cidades brasileiras.

Além disso, valorizamos a diversidade e estamos comprometidos com a promoção da inclusão e equidade em nossos times. Por isso, temos vagas destinadas aos grupos minorizados priorizados em nossa estratégia. Esta vaga é afirmativa para Pessoas com Deficiência.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Realizar a experimentação e venda de produtos com foco em satisfação e fidelização do cliente, assegurando a operação de caixa, limpeza, organização e reposição de produtos em loja.
  • Responsável pela abertura e/ou fechamento de loja.
  • Realiza o atendimento dos clientes que chegam através das iniciativas digitais.
  • Participa de todos os Treinamentos oferecidos pela empresa.
  • Responsável pela entrega de suas metas.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Médio Completo;
  • Experiência na área comercial;
  • Desejável experiência em lojas de varejo;
  • Vivência com maquiagem e/ou cosméticos será um diferencial
  • Conhecimento do pacote office.

Informações adicionais

O cuidado é a nossa essência!

Por isso, garantimos que você tenha benefícios diferenciados: um portfólio com mais de 20 opções, pensado para zelar pela sua saúde, bem-estar e de toda a sua família.

Saúde

Plano de saúde (extensível aos dependentes legais)

Plano odontológico (extensível aos dependentes legais com co-participação)

Psicoterapia online gratuita (2 sessões no mês e extensível ao dependentes legais)

Campanhas anuais de vacinação gratuitas: gripe e HPV

Wellhub (antigo gympass)- Plataforma de bem-estar que promove o cuidado físico e mental, com acesso gratuito aos 10 melhores apps de autocuidado e planos mensais em academias e estúdios parceiros.

Apoio para país atípicos

Alimentação e seu deslocamento

  • Vale refeição com bônus no Natal
  • Vale transporte

Associação Grupo Boticário (opcional)

Convênios e parcerias, experiências, loja multimarcas, descontos exclusivos, academias total pass, cursos e muito mais!

Grupo Boticário: De uma pequena farmácia de manipulação à maior franquia de cosméticos do planeta. Somos um Grupo com 15 marcas que está presente em mais de 40 países, com mais de 4 mil lojas físicas, líder de e-commerce de beleza no Brasil e mais de 19 mil colaboradores diretos. Temos um ecossistema próprio de beleza, que vai da indústria ao ponto de venda, da logística ao varejo, do laboratório ao coração das consumidoras e das nossas inovações na palma da sua mão. Acreditamos que o futuro mais bonito é aquele que construímos juntos, por isso, até 2030 temos compromissos ambiciosos voltados para o impacto positivo em dimensões humanas, ambientais e em nossos processos produtivos.

Ganhamos o ranking "Employer Branding Awards 2025" do Glassdoor, que nos elegeu a melhor empresa para se trabalhar no setor de varejo no Brasil! Reconhecimento baseado em avaliações voluntárias e anônimas de nossos colaboradores e ex-colaboradores sobre como é trabalhar aqui.

Reinventamos a beleza por meio da tecnologia, inovação, diversidade e sustentabilidade com: O Boticário, Eudora, Quem Disse, Berenice?, Vult, O.U.i, Dr. JONES, TRUSS e do marketplace Beleza na Web, além de atuarmos com produtos licenciados como Australian Gold, Bio Oil e Linha de cuidados Pampers.

Contexto e Projeto

A AVSI Brasil é uma organização da sociedade civil, sem fins lucrativos, criada em 2007, que atua com foco na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade. Trabalha em parceria com atores da cooperação internacional, setor público e iniciativa privada. Vinculada à Fundação AVSI, ONG italiana atuante no Brasil desde os anos 1980, tem como missão promover o protagonismo das pessoas em seu desenvolvimento, de suas famílias e comunidades. Implementa projetos sociais com base em uma metodologia de desenvolvimento integral e solidário, voltada à autonomia e à dignidade humana.

Neste contexto a AVSI mobiliza, operacionaliza e gerencia os Programas Sociais de Sustentabilidade em comunidades de baixa renda.

title: Head of Finance, Brazil
description:
CONMED Corporation is a progressive, global medical device company, operating in 20 countries. Through thoughtful leadership, innovation and teamwork, we are changing the future of healthcare. Our 3,500 employees worldwide make meaningful contributions, positively impact the business, and advance in their careers as our company and product portfolio grows.

We are a leader in Orthopedics, General Surgery, Gynecology, Gastroenterology, Pulmonology, and Anesthesiology and our employees enjoy challenging and diverse job opportunities across these varied specializations. CONMED is headquartered in the United States. Our international presence includes more than 20 locations throughout Canada, Europe, Australia, Latin America, Asia, North America, and the Middle East.

JOB DESCRIPTION

The Finance Director for Brazil is responsible for leading all financial operations, ensuring full compliance with local regulations, strengthening internal controls, optimizing financial performance, developing and supporting strategic business objectives. This role is pivotal in elevating governance, audit readiness, and operational discipline across the Brazilian organization.

This role oversees FP&A, Controllership, Reporting, Accounting, Tax, Treasury, Internal Controls, Compliance, and Financial Governance, while partnering closely with the Country Manager and regional/global Finance leadership to drive sustainable growth, profitability, strong governance and disciplined execution.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Strategic & Financial Leadership
  • Develop and execute financial strategies aligned with corporate objectives and Brazil’s dynamic economic and regulatory environment.
  • Lead the annual budgeting, forecasting, cash planning, and long‑range planning processes for Brazil.
  • Serve as a strategic partner to the Country Manager and senior leadership team, providing actionable insights to influence commercial, operational, and organizational decisions.
  • Monitor market trends, FX volatility, reimbursement dynamics, inflationary pressures, and competitor behavior to inform financial strategy.
Financial Reporting, Compliance & Audit Readiness
  • Oversee monthly, quarterly, and annual closing processes, ensuring accuracy, transparency, and timely reporting under Brazilian GAAP, IFRS, and corporate accounting standards (including US GAAP, if applicable).
  • Ensure complete, timely, and compliant statutory reporting, tax filings, SPED obligations (ECD/ECF), and other regulatory submissions.
  • Lead the Brazil Audit Remediation Plan, ensuring closure of all audit findings (high/medium/low risk) within established timelines.
  • Strengthen governance, documentation discipline, and financial process transparency to achieve “audit-ready, always” standards.
  • Manage external relationships with auditors (Big 4), tax authorities, banks, and regulatory bodies, representing the company with professionalism and financial rigor.
Treasury, Cash Flow & Working Capital Management
  • Own end‑to‑end cash flow, liquidity planning, and working capital performance (AR, AP, inventory).
  • Lead banking relationships, credit facility management, financial instruments, FX operations, and covenant monitoring.
  • Optimize capital structure, credit utilization, hedging strategies, and funding needs in alignment with corporate Treasury.
  • Drive improvements in collections, DSO, inventory turns, and payment terms to enhance cash generation.
Performance Management & Business Partnering
  • Deliver comprehensive financial analysis, including P&L performance, balance sheet quality, KPI trends, pricing, and margin enhancement opportunities.
  • Evaluate commercial strategies, business cases, investments, and distributor economics across franchises, customers, and Brazil geographies.
  • Collaborate closely with Sales, Marketing, and Operations to improve pricing governance, cost‑to‑serve, product mix optimization, and portfolio profitability
Internal Controls, Governance & Risk Management
  • Design, implement, and continuously strengthen internal controls aligned with SOX, corporate governance frameworks, and Brazilian regulatory requirements.
  • Lead governance of Fixed‑asset tracking and mobility controls, Inventory accuracy, reconciliations, and reporting reliability (including 3PL and distributor consignment)
  • Build and maintain a comprehensive risk register, governance cadence, and audit calendar.
Systems, ERP & Digital Finance
  • Lead optimization and governance of ERP and reporting systems, improving data integrity, and reporting accuracy.
  • Implement analytics and BI tools to enhance management dashboards, forecasting, and business decision‑making.
Team Leadership & Organizational Development
  • Lead, mentor, and develop a high‑performing Finance organization across Accounting, FP&A, Tax, Treasury, and Controls.
  • Build strong bench strength and raise capability in financial governance, technical accounting, tax, and analytics.
  • Lead the team through transformational change, strengthening culture, accountability, and execution discipline
  • Foster effective cross‑functional partnerships with Operations, Commercial, Supply Chain, and Service teams.

QUALIFICATIONS

Experience
  • Minimum 7–10 years in senior finance leadership roles (Finance Director, Country Controller, CFO, or equivalent) within multinational environments.
  • Proven experience in a similar leadership role or demonstrated potential to successfully assume such responsibilities.
  • Proven track record in governance turnarounds, internal controls design, and complex compliance environments.
  • Significant experience managing cash flow, working capital, treasury, and banking relationships.
  • Demonstrated expertise in Accounting, FP&A, Tax (including indirect taxes), Treasury, and statutory reporting.
  • Experience in healthcare, pharmaceuticals, or medical devices preferred; understanding of distributors and regulated markets is a plus.
  • Deep understanding of Brazil’s financial, tax, and regulatory landscape.
  • Strong command of Brazilian GAAP, IFRS, and corporate reporting frameworks including US GAAP
  • Advanced analytical thinking with ability to translate data into insights and influence senior decision‑makers.
  • Strong systems orientation, with hands‑on ERP experience (SAP/Oracle) and BI/reporting tools.
  • Exceptional communication skills in Portuguese and English, both written and spoken.
  • Strong leadership presence with the ability to drive accountability, lead change, and elevate organizational capability.
  • High degree of integrity, assertiveness, discipline, and ownership in managing financial governance.
Education & Credentials
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field (required).
  • MBA or advanced degree in Finance, Controllership, or related field (preferred).
  • Professional certification such as CRC, CPA, CMA, or equivalent strongly preferred.
  • Additional credentials in internal controls, audit, or compliance are a plus.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Sobre a Abbott

A Abbott é líder global em saúde, desenvolvendo uma ciência inovadora para melhorar a saúde das pessoas. Estamos sempre olhando para o futuro, antecipando mudanças na ciência e em tecnologias médicas.

Trabalhando na Abbott

Na Abbott, você pode realizar um trabalho importante, crescer e aprender, cuidar de si mesmo e de sua família, ser você mesmo e viver de maneira plena. Você terá acesso a:

  • Desenvolvimento de carreira em uma empresa internacional onde é possível crescer na carreira dos seus sonhos
  • Benefícios como Assistência Médica e Odontológica, Seguro de Vida, Previdência Privada, Subsidio de Medicamentos, Desconto para compra de ações da Abbott, entre outros.
  • Uma empresa reconhecida mundialmente como um ótimo lugar para se trabalhar em dezenas de países e nomeada como uma das empresas mais admiradas do mundo pela revista Fortune.
  • Entre as melhores grandes empresas para se trabalhar, bem como um dos melhores lugares para se trabalhar nas categorias de diversidade mães que trabalham, executivas e cientistas.
  • Políticas de trabalho flexíveis que permitem um equilíbrio saudável entre vida pessoal e profissional.
  • Um ambiente onde cada pessoa é ouvida e valorizada.

MISSÃO

Coordenar as atividades de Pré-Formulação, garantindo o desenvolvimento de formulações e processos seguros, robustos e com seus parâmetros críticos identificados. Desenvolver equipes de alta performance, promovendo o aumento do portfólio da Abbott em acordo com as normas e políticas praticadas pela Abbott e colaboração com as áreas Comerciais e de Operações. Realizar e avaliar todas as análises de pré-formulação que suportam o processo de desenvolvimento de produtos.

ATRIBUIÇÕES

· Coordenar a equipe de Pré-Formulação e o conteúdo técnico científico elaborado; através de um processo racional e padronizado de desenvolvimento, baseado em ciência e investigação, visando sempre a qualidade no processo de desenvolvimento;

· Promover o desenvolvimento de novos produtos, formulações e processos de fabricação garantindo o aumento do portfólio da empresa em acordo com o plano comercial da Abbott;

· Ter conhecimento robusto e aprofundado sobre os princípios de Pré-formulação, tais como a utilização de todos os equipamentos relacionados, pesquisas bibliográficas e elaboração de relatórios técnicos que suportem a criação de racional técnico para o desenvolvimento de produtos;

· Promover as iniciativas de QbD/DoE no contexto de desenvolvimento de produtos;

· Coordenar pessoas, contribuindo de forma efetiva para o desenvolvimento interpessoal, aumento de performance, detecção de habilidades e pontos de melhoria para criação de uma equipe de alta performance;

· Coordenar fluxos e processos, mantendo os custos e escopo dos projetos em linha com o cronograma e detectando possíveis falhas e riscos para identificar oportunidades de melhoria e evitar atrasos.

· Responsável pelas interações com os serviços terceirizados relacionados;

· Avaliar e elaborar viabilidade para novos projetos, mapeando e identificando as oportunidades, bem como dar suporte para os times de galênico, analítico e suprimentos no centro de desenvolvimento.

· Responsável pelos estudos de deformulação/engenharia reversa que orientem o desenvolvimento de produtos.

· Participar da revisão dossiê técnico na parte de pré-formulação para submissão na ANVISA ou outras agências reguladoras regionais e globais;

· Responsável por pesquisar, avaliar e apresentar novas oportunidades de tecnologias para a área de pré-formulação;

· Responsável por todas as atividades relacionadas à pré-formulação conforme descrito em PO atualizados;

· Garantir a padronização das atividades relacionadas ao setor, através da elaboração e/ou revisão dos Procedimentos Operacionais (PO);

· Garantir para que a área de pré-formulação esteja sempre de acordo com as normas de GMP e EHS;

· Conduzir as ações e decisões sob responsabilidade do cargo respeitando o Código de Conduta Comercial da empresa;

· Estar atualizado com a legislação vigente para desenvolvimento de novos produtos e relacionadas.

ESCOLARIDADE

- Superior completo em Farmácia, Engenharia Química ou Química.

- Mestrado ou doutorado na área de caracterização de materiais ou afins que contemplem técnicas relacionadas à pré-formulação.

CONHECIMENTOS

- Qualidade, GMP, Legislação de Medicamentos e pacote office.

- Conhecimentos aprofundados sobre DSC, TGA, Infravermelho, Raman, difração de raio-X, e analizadores de partículas por difração a laser.

- Desejável conhecimento em sistema SAP ou sistema similar e Segurança do Trabalho.

- Inglês avançado.

EXPERIÊNCIA

Acima de 6 anos de experiência em Desenvolvimento de Produtos, especificamente na área de Pré-formulação.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Ai & Orchestration)
description:
Senior Software Engineer (AI & Orchestration) Coru•Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Descrição da vaga

Company Description

A Coru é líder em soluções de experiência de usuário para empresas, focada em desafiar o convencional por meio de sua plataforma inteligente e assistente digital ADI. Oferecemos experiências digitais humanizadas e hiperpersonalizadas, o que aumenta a geração de receita e a eficiência operacional de nossos parceiros.

Mais informações: Coru Website

Job Description

Como Senior Software Engenieer, você irá liderar a arquitetura e o desenvolvimento da nossa plataforma de orquestração de agentes de IA. A sua missão não é "reinventar a roda" no que diz respeito aos LLMs, mas seme construir uma infraestrutura robusta, escalável e flexível que integre as melhores soluções do mercado numa experiência de utilizador perfeita. Será uma peça fundamental na evolução da nossa plataforma para um orquestrador de IA de classe mundial.

Responsabilidades

1. Arquitetura e Orquestração

  • Design do sistema : arquitetar micros serviços escaláveis e camadas de orquestração que possam lidar com vários fornecedores de IA e fluxos de trabalho complexos de agentes;
  • Estratégia de integração : avaliar e integrar serviços de IA de terceiros (OpenAI, Anthropic, LangChain, etc.), garantindo alta disponibilidade e eficiência de custos;

Desenvolvimento de API : projetar e manter APIs de alto desempenho e arquiteturas orientadas a eventos para dar suporte a interações em tempo real com agentes.

2. Full-Stack Development (Node.js / React)

  • Excelência em backend : criar serviços seguros, testáveis e sustentáveis usando NestJS e TypeScript;
  • Integração de frontend : colaborar no frontend Next.js / React para garantir que resultados complexos de IA sejam apresentados de forma intuitiva para os utilizadores;

Gestão de bases de dados : projetar e otimizar esquemas de bases de dados relacionais (SQL) para dar suporte à gestão complexa de estados para agentes de IA.

3. Produtividade aumentada por IA

Fluxo de trabalho moderno : usar e defender ativamente ferramentas de desenvolvimento baseadas em IA (Cursor, GitHub Copilot) para acelerar a entrega e manter a qualidade do código.

Evolução contínua: manter-se atualizado sobre as ferramentas e estruturas de IA mais recentes para garantir que a nossa camada de orquestração permaneça na vanguarda.

4. Liderança e Mentoria

  • Visão técnica : fornecer orientação técnica sobre decisões de "Build vs buy" relacionadas com componentes de IA;

Melhores práticas: defender código limpo, CI / CD e padrões rigorosos de documentação dentro da equipa de engenharia.

Requisitos Técnicos

  • Experiência : Mais de 5 anos de experiência profissional em desenvolvimento de software;
  • Backend : Forte proficiência em Node.js e TypeScript (experiência com NestJS é uma vantagem significativa);
  • Frontend : Sólida experiência com React e Next.js;
  • Bases de dados : Conhecimento especializado em SQL (PostgreSQL, MySQL ou similar);
  • Cloud & DevOps : Experiência com AWS / GCP / Azure, Docker e pipelines CI / CD modernos;

Ferramentas de IA: Conforto e alta proficiência na utilização de assistentes de codificação de IA (Cursor, Copilot) para aumentar a produtividade pessoal e da equipa.

Competências Essenciais

  • Mentalidade generalista : capacidade de resolver problemas em toda a pilha sem estar vinculado a um nicho específico "apenas de IA";
  • Pensamento arquitetônico : capacidade de projetar sistemas modulares e fáceis de adaptar à medida que o panorama da IA muda;

Orientado para resultados : focado em entregar valor ao utilizador, em vez de projetar ferramentas internas de forma excessiva.

Desejável / Plus

  • Experiência na criação ou manutenção de fluxos de trabalho ou orquestradores Agentic;
  • Familiaridade com bases de dados vetoriais (Pinecone, Weaviate) ou arquiteturas RAG;
  • Experiência com Python (para pontes de serviço de IA específicas);

Compreensão da observabilidade e gestão de custos de LLM.

Você tem o perfil para ser um Coru?

Temos a convicção de que o mais importante de Coru são as pessoas, por isso é fundamental que você faça um “Fit” cultural com toda a equipe. Estes são os pilares da nossa cultura :

  • Somos Todos Líderes.
  • Rendirse jamás!
  • El único problema que no podemos resolver es aquel del que no podemos hablar.
  • All together : Diversidad de historias y vivencias. Diferentes visiones traen mayores horizontes.

Você está #TheOne?

  • Cartão de benefícios flexível Caju
  • Salário competitivo
  • Convênio médico Alice e odontológico Amil sem coparticipação
  • Somos uma empresa "Remote First"
  • Plano de carreira em uma empresa em rápido crescimento
  • Fazer parte de uma empresa de tecnologia que está revolucionando o mercado e melhorando a vida das pessoas em cada interação.

Cargo

Agente de Serviço ao Passageiro

Descrição

O Agente de Serviço ao Passageiro é responsável por oferecer atendimento de qualidade, suporte e assistência aos passageiros. Este profissional atua como o principal ponto de contato entre a empresa e os clientes, lidando com uma variedade de situações e oferecendo soluções rápidas e eficazes. O objetivo principal é garantir a satisfação dos passageiros e contribuir para uma experiência de viagem tranquila e eficiente.

Esta é uma vaga exclusiva para o Aeroporto do Galeão (GIG)!

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Executar as atividades operacionais nas áreas de loja, check-in, despacho operacional, partidas, chegadas e bagagens.
  • Receber e acolher os passageiros, proporcionando um atendimento cortês e profissional.
  • Fornecer informações sobre horários, itinerários, políticas das empresas clientes e procedimentos de embarque e desembarque.
  • Ajudar a resolver questões e reclamações dos passageiros de forma eficiente e amigável.
  • Conferir documentos de viagem, bilhetes e identificação para garantir que tudo esteja em conformidade com as políticas e regulamentações vigentes das empresas clientes.
  • Oferecer suporte a passageiros com necessidades especiais, como pessoas com deficiência, idosos e famílias com crianças.
  • Gerenciar o processo de embarque e desembarque, garantindo que todas as operações sejam realizadas de maneira segura e organizada.
  • Manter comunicação constante com a equipe de operações e outras áreas para garantir a coordenação eficaz e a resolução de problemas.
  • Manter registros precisos das interações com os passageiros e das operações diárias, conforme necessário.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino médio completo; formação superior é um diferencial.
  • Inglês a partir do nível intermediário.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação verbal e escrita.
  • Habilidade para lidar com situações estressantes, empatia, paciência e boa disposição para trabalhar em equipe.
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar em escala, incluindo fins de semana e feriados.
  • Requisitos físicos: coordenação motora ampla e fina, destreza, articulação dos membros superiores e inferiores, postura variável, rotação e flexão do tronco e esforço físico esporádico para auxílio no carregamento de malas e remoção de itens da aeronave, locomoção e deambulação por toda extensão do aeroporto e condução de veículo para transporte interno de clientes.
  • Requisitos sensoriais: acuidade visual para condução de veículo, análise documental e suporte aos clientes; percepção auditiva para atendimento telefônico e a detecção de sinais sonoros emergenciais em áreas operacionais.
  • Requisitos neuropsíquicos: atenção, concentração, habilidade organizacional, criatividade, interpretação de dados e iniciativa para solução de situações causais.

description:
Gerente de Resseguro (Vida)

Você prospera em um ambiente dinâmico e desafiador, que demande uma atuação multidisciplinar? Possui experiência broker de resseguros, com vivência no produto seguro e resseguro de vida ou não vida? Aon está no negócio de melhores decisões. Na Aon, moldamos decisões para melhor proteger e enriquecer a vida das pessoas no mundo todo. title: PSICOLOGO
description:
As a Clinic Manager at Fresenius Medical Care, you’ll manage the daily operations of our outpatient centers. More importantly, you’ll be the key driver in carrying out our mission: To deliver superior care that improves the quality of life of every patient, every day, setting the standard by which others in the health care industry are judged. This is accomplished by hiring, developing and inspiring a multi‑disciplinary team, collaborating with physicians, tracking and delivering superior patient outcomes and monitoring regulatory and safety requirements. Strong management skills are required and prior direct patient care experience is needed for occasions when the team needs a helping hand.

Patient Care Technicians (PCTs) at Fresenius Medical Care support and collaborate with RNs to provide dialysis treatment to several patients at a time while maintaining the functionality of the clinic. This involves prepping and testing equipment, reviewing treatment sheets, and opening the clinic at 4am for first shift. PCTs have a combination of technical skills and genuine passion needed to develop deep relationships with patients and improve their quality of life. Qualified candidates have prior customer service, healthcare and direct patient care experience, and will have the opportunity to learn the discipline of dialysis.

Fresenius Medical Care nurses are on the front line of patient care, improving the quality of life of every patient, every day. That means providing dialysis care to 10‑12 patients at any given time, and collaborating with our multi‑disciplinary team to deliver a unique care plan to each one of them. This role is all about relationships and the bond you’ll create with patients and their families. Prior dialysis nursing experience is helpful, but many successful candidates come from a background in ICU, PCU and/or surgery.

Inpatient RNs at Fresenius Medical Care perform dialysis treatments on an acute patient population in a hospital setting, including ICU, ER, Rehab, and Med/Surg units. What makes this role truly unique is the level of autonomy you’ll enjoy. Inpatient nurses are specifically accountable for administering and assessing each patient’s treatment plan. And because dialysis is a critical treatment for many hospital procedures and health conditions, you’ll have the opportunity to work with a wide variety of patients. Ideal candidates possess leadership skills and independence needed to make quick decisions in a fast‑paced environment. Must be capable of educating patients and providing exceptional customer service to our partners. Six months to one year of dialysis experience or some form of critical care nursing experience are also required.

title: Chief Operating Officer
description:
Position Overview

We are seeking a Chief Operating Officer (COO) for overseeing the day-to-day administrative and operational functions of the business. Reporting directly to the CEO, the COO ensures the company executes its strategy efficiently, drives operational scalability, and maintains a high-performance culture across all departments.

Key Responsibilities

Operational Leadership & Management

Oversee Daily Operations : Direct and control all day-to-day activities across critical departments, including Operations, HR, IT, and other core business functions.

Process Optimization : Design, implement, and continuously monitor standardized procedures and workflows to maximize efficiency and productivity across the organization.

Risk Management : Identify, evaluate, and mitigate key operational risks to ensure compliance, business continuity, and organizational stability.

Strategic Planning & Execution

Strategy Implementation : Translate the CEO's long-term vision and strategic goals into clear, actionable operational plans and departmental targets.

Performance Monitoring : Establish, track, and analyze key performance indicators (KPIs) and metrics, reporting performance insights to the CEO and recommending corrective actions.

Growth & Scalability : Lead initiatives that build the necessary infrastructure, technology, and organizational structure to support and manage sustainable company growth.

Financial & Resource Stewardship

Budget Oversight : Collaborate with the CFO to manage the company's operating budget, controlling expenses and identifying opportunities to improve cost efficiency and profit margins.

Resource Allocation : Manage and allocate internal resources (personnel, technology, and capital) effectively to ensure all strategic projects and operations are fully supported.

Talent & Culture Development

Leadership Mentorship : Mentor and guide department heads and the senior leadership team, fostering a culture of accountability and continuous professional development.

Culture Champion : Act as a champion for the company's core values, ensuring the internal culture supports high performance and drives overall employee engagement and retention.

Required Skills & Qualifications

Experience & Executive Skills

Experience : Minimum of 4 + years of progressive leadership experience.

Operational Expertise : Proven track record in scaling operations, driving organizational efficiency, and managing complex cross-departmental functions.

Leadership : Demonstrated ability to mentor senior management, lead large teams, and foster a culture of accountability and high performance.

Process Knowledge : Expert knowledge of process improvement methodologies (e.g., Lean, Six Sigma) and strategic planning frameworks.

Education & Certification

Education : Bachelor’s Degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, or a related field.

Relevant Certifications : Certifications in Executive Leadership, Strategic Management, or Process Improvement (e.g., Lean Six Sigma Black Belt) are highly beneficial.

What We Offer

Strategic Impact : Opportunity to directly influence and execute the company’s core business strategy alongside the CEO and Board.

Executive Leadership : The chance to lead and mentor a high-caliber team across all major operational units.

title: Chief Executive Officer
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth. Here is what we offer:

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Purpose of Job

The Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of Howard University (HU) Faculty Practice Plan (FPP) has responsibility for the achievement of the strategic, operational, and financial goals of HU FPP. This position is responsible for the day-to-day operations and execution of the strategic vision for the HU FPP, including overseeing and directing organizational and physician alignment, operating and financial efficiency of clinical enterprises, practice management, revenue cycle services, expansion of referral sources, information technology and electronic health record management implementation, managed care contracting, and marketing and public relations.

This position is responsible for ensuring that high quality, innovative, and financially sustainable operations are in place and effectively managed to support HU FPP. The CEO of HU FPP will help to ensure that HU FPP is well-positioned in a rapidly evolving and competitive environment through optimized and systematic physician practice management. Additionally, in conjunction with the management team, this position will lead efforts to collaborate with community healthcare providers to enhance patient access in the communities served by HU FPP.

Job Responsibilities

Profit and Loss (P&L) responsibility for the operations of HU FPP, including all aspects of effective operational and financial management and reporting, managed care contracting, and operational and capital budgeting.

Implement operational processes and drive efficiencies at HU FPP to reduce administrative burden for HU FPP physicians.

Develop and implement key initiatives to improve deficiencies ascertained through the evaluation of operations.

Collaborate with Physician Enterprise leadership to apply effective processes, practice management tools, and best practices to the management of HU FPP.

Evaluate the organizational structure for HU FPP, identifying the core competencies for each organizational unit, and effectively designing the relationships between organizational units to drive effective governance.

Identify organizational goals, establish baseline metrics, development of key performance indicators, and standardize processes, and monitoring of performance against goals, including those related to patient satisfaction, physician engagement and satisfaction, employee engagement, patient access, clinical excellence and patient safety, efficiency and effectiveness and financial performance.

Create and maintain a culture of accountability and serve as a resource for attaining performance metrics in all areas of the HU FPP.

Implement Adventist HealthCare standard management approach across all departments at HU FPP.

Work with Adventist HealthCare and HU for the development of the strategic vision for HU FPP and execution of strategic initiatives.

Effective communication of the mission, vision, values, and strategic vision of HU FPP to internal and external stakeholders.

Closely collaborate with the Chief Medical Officer to drive achieving mutual goals and cultivating long-term, collaborative relationships with HU FPP physicians.

Evaluate strategic partnership opportunities with community-based organizations, payors, and other community stakeholders.

Identify new opportunities in population health and with alternative payment models.

Ability to work collaboratively with Chairs, Leadership and departmental Administrators, Physicians and Staff from diverse background and perspectives, across clinical and academic missions of an academic medical center to ensure efficient, effective clinic operations, while creating an environment conducive to engagement and satisfaction among physicians, other practitioners, and clinical staff.

Required Qualifications: Competencies

Knowledge

  • Knowledge of advanced primary care practice principles and Patient-Centered Medical Home (PCMH) principles.
  • Knowledge of principles and practices of health care practice operations and management sufficient to manage, direct, and coordinate the operations of a health care organization’s physician practices.
  • Knowledge of the purposes, organization, and policies of the community's health systems sufficient to interact with other health care providers.
  • Knowledge of the physician recruitment and development strategies.
  • Knowledge of sophisticated practice management operations and qualified and conversant in Medicare Access and CHIP Reauthorization Act (MACRA) and Merit-based Incentive Payment System (MIPS) strategies and value-based reimbursement such as PCMH programs.
  • Knowledge and experience at a large academic health program that included practice plan administration services.

Skills

  • Skill in exercising a high degree of initiative, judgment, discretion, and decision-making to achieve organizational objectives.
  • Skill in analyzing situations accurately and taking effective action.
  • Skill in establishing and maintaining effective working relationships with employees, policy-making bodies, third-party payers, patients, and the public.
  • Skill in organizing work, making assignments, and achieving goals and objectives.
  • Skill in exercising judgment and discretion in developing, applying, interpreting, and coordinating departmental policies and procedures.

Abilities

  • Ability to assume responsibility.
  • Ability to establish and maintain quality control standards.
  • Ability to organize and integrate organizational priorities and deadlines.
  • Ability to communicate, including the ability to negotiate and resolve conflicts and build teams.
  • Skill in articulating and presenting data, information and ideas in a clear and concise manner.
  • Ability to communicate with physicians, academic department leaders and senior administrators to maintain coordination with other organizational programs.

Required Qualifications: Education and Experience

Education

  • M.B.A. or similar management degree required.

Implement operational processes and drive efficiencies at HU FPP to reduce administrative burden for HU FPP physicians.

Experience

  • Minimum 10 years executive-level experience including 7 years of experience in the administration of a health care organization.

Supervisory/Management Experience

Experience in a large academic health system, including experience with practice plan administration.

title: Treinador Esportivo (Ginástica Artística Masculina)
description:
Que tal trabalhar em um clube de futebol referência em gestão?

Após um árduo trabalho de reestruturação, o Clube de Regatas do Flamengo tornou-se uma das marcas de maior credibilidade no cenário nacional, atraindo grandes parceiros comerciais e investindo pesado em infraestrutura e recursos humanos. Aqui a gente procura os melhores craques para todas as modalidades - inclusive nos setores administrativos! Dos mais jovens talentos com sede de aprendizado aos profissionais mais gabaritados e experientes para gerir nossas equipes, aqui tem espaço para todos, de todas as cores, crenças e gêneros.

Venha ser um dos craques do maior clube poliesportivo do Brasil!

O Flamengo é a maior marca de futebol e o maior clube poliesportivo da América Latina. Conhecido por ter a Maior Torcida do Mundo, com mais de 48 milhões de rubro-negros apaixonados espalhados pelo mundo, foi fundado em 1895 e, desde então, coleciona títulos em diversas modalidades esportivas ao longo de sua história centenária. No futebol, carro-chefe do clube, o Flamengo é octacampeão brasileiro, pentacampeão da Copa do Brasil, maior vencedor do Campeonato Carioca com 38 títulos, tricampeão da Copa Libertadores e campeão mundial de clubes, taças erguidas por grandes craques do futebol que vestiram o Manto Sagrado e, é claro, pela Nação Rubro-Negra, sempre atuante como 12º jogador.

O clube colheu os frutos e os números se transformaram em resultado esportivo, com troféus erguidos pelo futebol e pelos esportes olímpicos, conquistando campeonatos nacionais de remo, basquete, ginástica artística, polo aquático, nado artístico e até mesmo esportes eletrônicos. Nos últimos Jogos Olímpicos, em Tóquio e Paris, o Mais Querido teve diversos representantes e fez bonito com as conquistas históricas das ginastas Rebeca Andrade, Jade Barbosa, Lorrane Oliveira e Flavia Saraiva, do canoísta Isaquias Queiroz e da judoca Rafaela Silva, todos atletas rubro-negros.

Já pensou em poder fazer parte de tudo isso?

Trabalhar no Flamengo é diferente de tudo que você já viveu…

Trabalhar com paixão é mágico e muito especial. Ser um colaborador do Flamengo é ver a história sendo escrita de perto, é ter a emoção como colega de trabalho, é sentir como é gratificante fazer parte de grandes conquistas, é fazer parte de uma família e de uma Nação. Venha trabalhar conosco, participar do presente, construir o futuro e valorizar o passado de uma instituição centenária que mexe com o coração de mais de 48 milhões de apaixonados.

Eternos ídolos já vestiram o Manto Sagrado, grandes craques formam nossas equipes, excelentes profissionais constroem a história de sucesso do Flamengo... O próximo pode ser você!

RAÇA…

Todo mundo sabe que quem joga pelo Flamengo tem que honrar o Manto Sagrado! Aqui, valorizamos muito o comprometimento, a dedicação, a superação, a resiliência. Para quem é craque do Mengão, não tem bola perdida: a gente entra firme na dividida e se destaca pelo profissionalismo. A busca é incessante pela excelência!

…AMOR E PAIXÃO!

Pessoas apaixonadas pelo que fazem e pelo Flamengo! Você verá que é muito fácil ter paixão pelo seu trabalho com a gente. Ética, transparência, honestidade, profissionalismo, respeito e integridade são titulares do nosso time em todas as partidas. Estamos sempre juntos com garra, otimismo e alegria para vencer!

CRAQUE FAZEMOS EM CASA

Zelo pelas pessoas, desenvolvimento e constante aperfeiçoamento. Aqui no Flamengo, queremos ensinar, mas também aprender com você! Muitas são as oportunidades de evoluir com o espírito rubro-negro. Somos um time e uma família!

Venha fazer parte dessa equipe!

  • Ensino superior em Educação Física.
  • Experiência como treinador(a) de base e/ou alto rendimento da modalidade Ginástica Artística.
  • Conhecimento profundo de elementos, regras e progressões da Ginástica Artística.

  • Supervisionar o aprendizado progressivo de novos elementos com foco em segurança.
  • Comunicar-se com equipe técnica, dirigentes e familiares das atletas.

  • Atualizar-se constantemente sobre regras do Código de Pontuação da FIG e adaptar as rotinas conforme mudanças.

Ele executa manutenções preventivas, corretivas, calibrações e ensaios, garantindo a disponibilidade dos equipamentos para o atendimento ao paciente, em conformidade com as normas técnicas e os procedimentos internos. Execução de Manutenções e Intervenções Técnicas

  • Realizar manutenções corretivas nos equipamentos médico-hospitalares, desde a abertura do chamado até a identificação da falha e a intervenção técnica, visando restaurar todas as funcionalidades e retomar a operação de forma segura.

Gestão de Equipamentos e Controle Patrimonial

  • Realizar o controle e rastreio de equipamentos por meio de rondas diárias, verificando o estado geral, a localização e a condição de uso, para garantir sua conservação e disponibilidade.

Acompanhamento e Suporte

Role Purpose

The Enterprise Architect role is responsible for designing and managing the overall architecture of an organization’s IT systems and infrastructure. This role involves aligning IT strategy with business goals, creating architectural frameworks, and ensuring that technology solutions are scalable, secure, and efficient. The Enterprise Architect collaborates with various internal and external stakeholders to identify technology needs and guide the implementation of IT initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Establish EA governance, EA frameworks, EA methodology and create EA artifacts, EA standards and best practices.
  • Design and promote architectural standards, guidelines, and best practices across the organization.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to identify business requirements and translate them into architectural solutions.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and industry trends to inform architectural decisions and recommendation.
  • Facilitate architecture review boards and governance processes to ensure compliance with architectural standards.
  • Provide guidance and support to project teams in implementing architectural solutions.
  • Instruct, manage, and mentor development teams.
  • Communicate enterprise architecture with other department managers within the organization, outsourcing providers and report on continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Oversee Change Control board, participate in Project Review Board to ensure adherence to architectural standards.

People Responsibilities (Total Team/DRs)

No

Key metrics

EA KPIs such as strategic alignment, business process optimization, innovation enablement, efficiency, architecture compliance and risk management.

Key internal relationships

CIO, Deputy CIO, Functional leads, Operations leads, GDPR team, Legal, Finance, Global Security, IT Security, Technology Services, System/Application Owners, Program/Opportunity leads.

Key external relationships

IT vendors in various markets, external consulting experts, EA colleagues at non-profit institutions with similar IT landscape, large global software providers, etc.

The ideal candidate

Essential

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, IT, or a related field
  • Master's degree in IT management, business management, or enterprise architecture
  • Certifications such TOGAF, CISSP (for cybersecurity focus), and cloud-specific certifications from providers like AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud are beneficial
  • 10 years of relevant experience in Enterprise Architecture, with a background in software engineering, network security, cloud computing, systems analysis, data management or other related fields.
  • Strong understanding of business needs, technology trends, and architectural frameworks.
  • Experience creating and maintaining comprehensive Enterprise Architecture frameworks.
  • Experience with architecture modelling tools CAD, BIM, and 3D modelling software.
  • Strong understanding of IT enterprise systems and platforms (Salesforce, NetSuite, Workday) and architectures
  • Deep knowledge of various technologies, including cloud computing, data management, networking, and security.
  • Ability to effectively communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to analyse complex business problems and develop innovative solutions.
  • Ability to lead and mentor development teams and influence stakeholders.
  • Experience with architectural frameworks and methodologies TOGAF or Zachman, and agile methodologies.
  • Experience with cloud computing, network security, data management, and application integration.
  • High level understanding and interest of geo-political implications of Open Society’s work.
  • Travel is required. Travel frequency depends on the role requirements.

Languages

  • An excellent knowledge of English

What We Offer

  • Exceptional opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact; from a generous annual professional development allowance for every employee to onsite training and learning conversations with visiting experts.
  • Excellent benefits and perks to promote well-being and a healthy work-life balance, including:

    • Exceptional retirement savings plan (non-contributory for employees) and life insurance.
    • Progressive paid parental leave, reproductive and family planning support, and much more.
  • A commitment to nurturing a diverse and inclusive workplace, so you can bring your whole self to work and make a positive impact.

Salary range: $145,666 - $161,851 (USD). The final offer is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skill set and level of experience.

Who We Are

Open Society Foundations aim to establish vibrant and inclusive democracies where governments are accountable to their citizens. Our operating model organizes grantmaking around specific, time-limited projects, developed alongside support for established partners, enabling us to respond swiftly to emerging needs. We are committed to promoting human dignity, equality, and rights; reimagining democratic ideals and practice; and advancing equity in governance systems.

Guided by our founder’s values and the belief in the art of the possible, we engage directly with global entities, individuals, and policymakers through grants, advocacy, impact investing, and strategic human rights litigation to drive positive change. At the heart of our mission is a deep commitment to rights, equity, and justice, inspiring every action we take.

Position Summary

The Chief Operating Officer (COO) of the Howard University Faculty Practice Plan (FPP) serves as the senior operational leader responsible for the strategic, financial, and administrative oversight of the physician enterprise. The COO ensures that all ambulatory and faculty practice operations function efficiently and are aligned with the mission of Howard University and its academic health enterprise.

The COO partners closely with the CEO / Executive Director of the FPP, clinical department chairs, practice administrators, hospital leadership, and the College of Medicine to drive performance, expand access, strengthen the patient experience, and support the clinical, educational, and research missions.

Key Responsibilities

Operational Leadership of the Physician Enterprise

Provide executive oversight of all ambulatory clinics, faculty practices, and related clinical operations.

Lead day-to-day operational performance including patient flow, scheduling, clinic throughput, call center performance, and care coordination.

Ensure that clinical operations meet standards of safety, quality, service excellence, and regulatory compliance.

Implement consistent operational policies, workflows, and performance standards across departments and practice sites.

Strategic Planning & Growth

Develop and execute strategies to support practice expansion, new clinical programs, and service line growth.

Assess market and demographic trends to inform future planning and provider network development.

Partner with University and hospital leadership to align practice operations with broader academic and clinical priorities.

Support recruitment planning, provider onboarding, and optimization of clinical FTE utilization.

Provider Access, Productivity & Performance Optimization

Lead initiatives to improve provider productivity, panel management, template design, and clinical capacity utilization.

Partner with department chairs and practice leaders to set and monitor operational KPIs (e.g., access metrics, cycle time, provider productivity, patient satisfaction).

Support performance review processes, compensation model implementation, and incentive alignment.

Financial & Revenue Cycle Management

Collaborate with the CFO to manage operating budgets, financial forecasts, and profitability of service lines.

Provide operational leadership for revenue cycle functions (e.g., registration, scheduling, charge capture workflows, documentation optimization, denial reduction).

Work with central revenue cycle leaders to ensure clean claims, timely billing, and improved collections.

Evaluate and optimize payer mix, managed care leverage, and ambulatory financial performance.

Systems, Technology & Data Integration

Oversee optimization of the electronic health record (EHR) and other clinical information systems to support efficient workflows.

Ensure accurate, real‑time dashboards and data analytics to drive decision‑making.

Champion the use of technology, automation, and digital health solutions to improve access and patient engagement.

Regulatory, Compliance & Quality Oversight

Ensure operational compliance with CMS, Joint Commission, ambulatory accreditation standards, HIPAA, OSHA, and related federal and local regulations.

Partner with quality leaders to strengthen ambulatory quality and patient safety programs.

Lead operational readiness for audits, surveys, and accreditation activities.

Leadership, Culture & People Management

Build and develop high‑performing administrative and operational teams.

Promote a culture of equity, accountability, service excellence, and continuous improvement.

Provide coaching, mentorship, and leadership development to practice managers and administrative staff.

Strengthen physician–administrative partnerships across departments.

Collaboration with Academic & Hospital Partners

Work closely with the College of Medicine to align clinical operations with teaching and training needs.

Coordinate with Howard University Hospital leadership to ensure smooth inpatient–outpatient continuum of care.

Assist in integrating residents and students into clinic operations in compliance with accreditation requirements.

Qualifications

Education: Master’s degree in Healthcare Administration, Business Administration, Public Health, or a related field required.

Additional certification in Lean, Six Sigma, or ambulatory operations preferred.

Experience

Minimum 10 years of progressive leadership experience in an academic medical center, faculty practice plan, or large multispecialty physician group.

Strong experience in ambulatory operations, physician enterprise management, and performance improvement.

Demonstrated success improving access, financial performance, and operational efficiency across multiple clinical departments.

Experience in a mission‑driven, culturally diverse, urban healthcare environment preferred.

Skills & Competencies

Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills.

Deep understanding of physician practice economics and healthcare reimbursement.

Demonstrated change management and project management capability.

Excellent interpersonal, communication, and physician‑relations skills.

Commitment to health equity, community engagement, and service to underserved populations.

About the Role We're looking for a Motion Designer with strong expertise in UX / UI to elevate our product experience through animation, micro-interactions, and motion-driven storytelling. You'll craft intuitive interfaces, define motion principles for our design system, and design flows that feel smooth, modern, and expressive.

This engagement is part of a larger product initiative, and strong performance may lead to future design phases.

We're seeking someone detail-oriented, proactive, and comfortable collaborating with product, engineering, and leadership in a remote, fast-paced environment.

  • Create 2D and 3D animations, parallax, or holographic-inspired elements, transitions, micro-interactions, banners, and Lottie or Framer Motion-ready assets

  • Build or refine a lightweight design system in Figma, including components, tokens, motion states, and documentation
  • Propose tasteful animation patterns that enhance usability rather than distract
  • Ensure all motion follows accessibility best practices (reduced motion, contrast, timing, cognitive load)
  • Deliver final assets with implementation notes for engineering teams
  • Collaborate closely with product to iterate quickly based on feedback

Requirements

  • 4, or more, years of experience as a Motion Designer with strong knowledge in UI / UX design
  • Proficiency with animation tools such as After Effects, Lottie, Rive, or Framer Motion
  • Knowledge of Spline, Blender, or other 3D prototyping tools
  • Portfolio demonstrating motion-first interfaces, refined UI, and strong UX thinking
  • Ability to articulate design decisions clearly and collaborate efficiently
  • Advanced English for communication with international teams
  • Nice to Have Experience building or maintaining design systems at scale
  • Familiarity with front-end animation frameworks (React, Framer Motion, CSS transitions)
  • Previous work in agile or fast-paced product teams

Why Join

Your work will directly shape how users experience motion in our product. This is a highly visible project with room for creativity and experimentation. You'll join a small, focused remote team that values craft, clarity, and smart design, and there's a strong chance for future collaboration as the product expands.

If you love designing beautiful, usable interfaces combined with thoughtful motion and interaction design, this role is a great fit.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Job Summary

We are seeking a Data Engineer to enhance the resilience and operational stability of our data pipelines, from factory floor to cloud repositories. This critical role will focus on building robust monitoring and support systems, and on accelerating our ability to understand and resolve system and pipeline breakdowns.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and integrate production support technologies and systems to improve data pipeline reliability.
  • Proactively identify vulnerabilities and implement systemic process oriented solutions to enhance pipeline resilience.
  • Develop and apply advanced analytics for proactive pipeline monitoring, anomaly detection, and performance optimization.
  • Conduct in-depth statistical analysis of pipeline performance, incident data, and root causes to drive continuous improvement.
  • Prepare and maintain comprehensive reports and dashboards with key performance indicators (KPIs) for measuring system and pipeline resiliency.
  • Collaborate with global team of data analysts, engineers, and leaders to rapidly troubleshoot and resolve data pipeline issues.
  • Interface with corporate areas, preparing technical documentation, reports, and presentations on pipeline health and improvements.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date documentation for systems, processes, and troubleshooting guides.
  • Assist in meeting data environment governance requirements, specifically related to pipeline data quality and integrity.

Knowledge and Technical Competencies

Soft skills: Organized, proactive, curious, sense of urgency and prioritization, and a strong feeling of ownership.

Technical expertise: Proven experience in systems support, data pipelines, database reliability engineering, and IT production support. Strong background in designing and implementing monitoring, alerting, and logging solutions.

Technical Skills: Proficiency in SQL (queries) and a scripting language (e.g., Python) for data analysis and automation. Hands‑on experience with GCP data technologies (e.g., BigQuery, Dataflow) and monitoring tools (e.g., Grafana, Cloud Monitoring). Familiarity with business intelligence tools (e.g., Looker, Power BI, Tableau) for dashboarding.

Desired qualifications: Knowledge of process industry KPIs. Familiarity with data governance platforms (e.g., Collibra) and data transformation tools (e.g., Dataform). Multilingual English / Spanish / Portuguese would be a plus. Experience with Production Support would be a plus.

Background: Degree in Engineering or Computer Science.

Diversidade e inclusão:

A Americanas S.A. acredita que diferentes perspectivas enriquecem o ambiente de trabalho. Por isso, temos o objetivo de promover um lugar cada vez mais diverso, inclusivo e acolhedor. Estamos construindo a cada dia uma cultura com base no respeito e valorização das diferenças, encorajando as pessoas a serem quem elas são, independente de gênero, etnia, raça, orientação sexual, religião ou deficiência. Job Overview

The Senior Project Controls Specialist uses best practices and knowledge of internal or external issues to improve the project controls discipline within McDermott. They will act as a resource for colleagues with less experience and share their conceptual and practical expertise related to the project controls discipline. The Senior Project Controls Specialist solves complex problems and uses their discipline‑specific knowledge to improve their products or services. The Senior Project Controls Specialist impacts a range of customer, operational, project, or service activities with the project controls team and other related teams and ensures that they are working within the appropriate guidelines and policies.

Qualifications

Essential Qualifications and Education:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management or a related field
  • Minimum of five (5) years of relevant experience in Project Controls, Cost Engineering, or Financial Analysis within an EPC or project‑driven environment
  • Proficiency in general office productivity tools, particularly spreadsheets, word processing, and presentation software
  • Strong understanding of project controls principles, including cost control, scheduling, forecasting, and performance measurement
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently while also leading collaborative efforts across global, multidisciplinary teams
  • Strong critical thinking, problem‑solving, and attention to detail, with the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast‑paced environment
  • Fluent in English with excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and engage stakeholders at all levels

Responsibilities

Key Tasks and Responsibilities:

  • Lead the development and deployment of advanced visual analytics to support project performance monitoring, forecasting, and executive‑level reporting
  • Apply data mining, statistical modeling, and trend analysis techniques to identify key performance indicators, cost drivers, and schedule risks across complex, multi‑phase projects
  • Integrate and link data from multiple internal and external sources to build robust, multi‑dimensional models that support real‑time decision‑making
  • Architect scalable data structures and implement standardized methods for data transformation, validation, and automation across project controls systems
  • Collaborate with cross‑functional teams—including engineering, procurement, construction, finance, and IT—to understand business needs and translate them into actionable data solutions
  • Interpret complex data requests and deliver clear, accurate, and insightful outputs that align with project and organizational objectives
  • Provide strategic insights by identifying correlations, anomalies, and emerging trends within large datasets to support proactive project management
  • Guide and mentor junior team members on data governance, reporting standards, and best practices for data management, storage, and security
  • Develop predictive models and forecasting tools based on historical data, current trends, and scenario planning to support long‑term project planning and risk mitigation
  • Support the implementation and continuous improvement of digital project controls tools and platforms, ensuring alignment with global EPC standards and practices
  • Lead or contribute to the development of internal training materials and knowledge‑sharing initiatives to elevate data literacy and project controls capabilities across the organization
  • Ensure compliance with internal controls, client requirements, and industry standards in all aspects of data handling and reporting.
  • Act as a subject matter expert in project data analytics, guiding Project Managers, Cost Engineers, and Executive Stakeholders on data‑driven decision‑making

Kuiper's Sales strategy and Go To Market plan is well defined and yet each working day is different from the next. Here at Amazon, we embrace our differences. We are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. title: Sr Front-end Engineer - LATAM Core (100% Remote)
description:
About The Job

Join the Commerce team at Hopper Technology Solutions (HTS) , the engine powering the travel portals for the world’s most iconic brands like Capital One, Air Canada, and Uber. HTS now represents over 85% of Hopper’s business , reaching over 400 million travelers globally. We aren't just building apps; we are architecting a high-scale, white-label commerce platform that processes billions of dollars in travel and fintech annually . We are looking for a high‑ownership Frontend Engineer to help us redefine B2B travel. At HTS, we thrive on a bottom‑up innovation culture . We don't wait for top‑down mandates; our engineers have the autonomy to identify performance levers, propose new product capabilities, and ship features that move the needle for our global partners. If you love a fast‑paced environment where your code directly impacts millions of users from day one, you belong here.

What Would Your Day-to-day Look Like

  • Design & Build at Scale: Architect and review code for world‑class, multi‑tenant travel portals that balance reusable white‑label foundations with partner‑specific customizations.
  • Autonomous Execution: Lead initiatives from concept to deployment. Our group operates with a low‑meeting culture, emphasizing deep work, strong alignment, and asynchronous decision‑making to maximize engineering velocity.
  • Product Innovation: Collaborate side‑by‑side with Product Managers and Designers to explore engineering improvements that enhance the user experience and drive partner growth.
  • Cross‑Functional Impact: Work seamlessly across Hopper’s ecosystem—integrating with our Scala‑based fintech services and GCP infrastructure to bring sophisticated travel features to market.

An ideal candidate has

  • Exceptional Technical Craft: Expert‑level proficiency in React and TypeScript, with a deep understanding of component architecture, state management, and web performance.
  • Product‑Minded Engineering: You anchor your conception of "quality" in the customer experience and understand how to translate business ambiguity into clear, scalable code.
  • Iterative DNA: A natural drive to deliver results fast. You know how to distinguish between "must‑be‑perfect" core logic and features that can be evolved through data‑driven iteration.
  • Systems Thinking: Experience (or a hunger to learn) managing complex frontends within a distributed systems environment, ensuring reliability for high‑stakes partner integrations.

Perks and benefits of working with us

  • Well‑funded and proven startup with large ambitions, competitive salary and the upsides of pre‑IPO equity packages.
  • Carrot Cash travel stipend.
  • Hopper will cover 100% of the employee premiums for EOR‑offered health, dental, life and short‑term disability insurances with SulAmerica.
  • Hopper offers employees in Brazil monthly meal vouchers.
  • Very generous parental leave.
  • Flexdesk All Access Pass & Work‑from‑home stipend.
  • Entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business.
  • Open communication with management and company leadership.
  • Small, dynamic teams = massive impact.

More About Hopper

At Hopper, we are on a mission to become the leading travel platform globally – powering Hopper’s mobile app, website and our B2B business, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions). By leveraging massive amounts of data and advanced machine learning algorithms, Hopper combines its world‑class travel agency offering with proprietary fintech products to bring transparency, flexibility and savings to travelers globally. JOB DESCRIPTION

você é uma pessoa que ama se conectar com gente e entender a história de cada cliente? aqui na FARM Rio, estamos à procura de quem se identifica com esses valores para fazer parte do nosso time de vendas . buscamos pessoas que se desafiam a criar experiências incríveis em cada atendimento e a colocar o talento em campo para alcançar os melhores resultados, sempre buscando surpreender e encantar em cada detalhe, fazendo viva a nossa cultura: ser gente boa , bom de gente e bom de jogo .

quer fazer parte de um time apaixonado por moda e por gente? vem pra FARM!

RESPONSIBILITIES AND ASSIGNMENTS

  • atendimento consultivo à cliente;
  • ser guardiã da experiência em loja, propagando a cultura da marca;
  • acompanhar de forma proativa toda a jornada do cliente na loja, desde a entrada até a saída, garantindo uma experiência de compra diferenciada;
  • foco na fidelização e realização do pós-venda (através da ferramenta Dito), mantendo nossas clientes sempre apaixonadas;
  • gerenciar suas próprias vendas e entregas, assegurando a eficiência;
  • impulsionar as vendas digitais, promovendo o código de vendedora e utilizando redes sociais, com foco em criar engajamento e gerar encantamento em cada interação;
  • manter o ambiente da loja organizado, seguindo os padrões de VM e produção de moda;
  • realizar o registro das vendas de pagamento digital, através da ferramenta Somabox, garantindo uma experiência de pagamento ágil e segura.

REQUIREMENTS AND QUALIFICATIONS

  • habilidade para trabalhar em equipe, com um espírito colaborativo e inclusivo;
  • facilidade de comunicação, com gentileza na oratória e “escutatória”;
  • interesse por moda, tendências, boas conversas e paixão pelo que faz;
  • domínio de ferramentas digitais e redes sociais, essenciais para uma marca que conecta o físico e o digital;
  • ensino médio completo;
  • flexibilidade de horário.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

quem faz parte do time comercial FARM tem direito à:

  • vale transporte;
  • para garantir o seu bem-estar e qualidade de vida: wellz (plataforma de saúde mental e bem estar)
